# Tink Digital

> Tink Digital is a New Zealand digital marketing agency founded by Tineke Madgwick, based in Whangamatā on the Coromandel Peninsula. It helps brands across New Zealand and Australia get found, understood and chosen across Google and AI search. Tagline: Trusted • Indexed • Noticed • Known.

## Services
- Trusted: brand strategy and positioning, tone of voice, PR and media relations, crisis communication
- Indexed: technical SEO, schema and structured data, entity optimisation, website builds on Next.js, Shopify and HubSpot
- Noticed: answer engine optimisation (AEO) and AI search visibility, ChatGPT business profile setup, search and social advertising
- Known: content strategy and creation, HubSpot email nurture and CRM automation, performance reporting

## About
Tineke Madgwick has around 20 years of marketing experience, including Marketing Manager at Swisse Wellness New Zealand and roles at L'Oréal and Ego Pharmaceuticals in Melbourne. She built a digital agency's AEO practice from the ground up. She holds a Communications degree majoring in Public Relations, and micro-credentials in SEO Strategy and AI in Marketing Practice.
